CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Private Sub Report_Open(Cancel As Integer)
On Error GoTo Report_Open_Err

    ' =====================
    ' Abrir Arquivo Sistema
    ' =====================
    
    Dim con As Object
    Dim rs As Object
    Dim stSql As String
    
    Set con = Application.CurrentProject.Connection
    stSql = "SELECT * FROM [Arquivo Sistema]"
    stSql = stSql & " WHERE [IDSistema] = 1"
    stSql = stSql & " ORDER BY [IDSistema];"
    Set rs = CreateObject("ADODB.Recordset")
    rs.Open stSql, con, 1
    
    If (rs.EOF) Then
        Me![NomeCliente].Caption = "Personalizar Cliente"
    Else
        Me![NomeCliente].Caption = rs![Cliente]
    End If

    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set con = Nothing
    
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Zerar Temp Movimento Contas", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Mov Contas Extrato A Financeiras", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Mov Contas Extrato B Financeiras", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Mov Contas Extrato C Financeiras", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Mov Contas Extrato D Financeiras", acViewNormal, acEdit
    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Mov Contas Extrato Monta Historico", acViewNormal, acEdit

Report_Open_Exit:
    Exit Sub

Report_Open_Err:
    MsgBox Error$
    Resume Report_Open_Exit

End Sub

Private Sub Report_Deactivate()
On Error GoTo Report_Deactivate_Err

    DoCmd.OpenQuery "F Zerar Temp Movimento Contas", acViewNormal, acEdit

Report_Deactivate_Exit:
    Exit Sub

Report_Deactivate_Err:
    MsgBox Error$
    Resume Report_Deactivate_Exit

End Sub
